content.summary: Work items generated from Rust DAP Debugger MVP commit plan

work_items.title: DAP client: content-length transport + request/response/event dispatch
acceptance_criteria: Content-length framing encodes and decodes DAP JSON-RPC messages over stdin/stdout
Request/response correlation via seq ID with timeout
Event listeners can be registered and receive typed events
Unit tests pass for framing round-trip and request/response matching

work_items.title: DAP session manager: Instance.state lifecycle + codelldb spawn/shutdown
acceptance_criteria: Instance.state holds at most one active DAP session per OpenCode instance
codelldb process is spawned with correct args and env
Bus events emitted for session created/terminated
Dispose handler kills codelldb process on Instance shutdown
State machine enforces valid transitions

work_items.title: debug_launch tool: initialize handshake + launch program under codelldb
acceptance_criteria: Tool.define debug_launch with Zod schema for program path and optional args
Executes initialize → launch → configurationDone handshake sequence
Returns session status including adapter capabilities
Permission ask for debug_launch before spawning
Clear error if codelldb not found or handshake fails

work_items.title: debug_breakpoint tool: set/clear breakpoints via DAP setBreakpoints
acceptance_criteria: Tool.define debug_breakpoint with Zod schema for file path and line numbers
Sends setBreakpoints request and returns confirmed breakpoint locations
Handles breakpoint verification (verified: true/false)
Permission ask for debug_breakpoint
Error if no active debug session

work_items.title: debug_eval tool: evaluate expressions + inspect variables + continue execution
acceptance_criteria: Tool.define debug_eval with Zod schema for expression, optional frameId, and action (evaluate/variables/continue/next/stepIn)
Auto-resolves threadId and frameId from cached stopped event when not provided
Evaluate returns result string; variables returns scoped variable list
Continue/next/stepIn resume execution; tool returns new stopped location or terminated status
Output truncated via Truncate.output for large results
Permission ask for debug_eval

work_items.title: Feature flag, config schema, and tool registry wiring
acceptance_criteria: OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_DAP flag added to flag.ts
Debug tools conditionally registered in registry.ts when flag is true
Config schema accepts optional dap section with codelldb path
Permission schema includes debug_launch, debug_breakpoint, debug_eval
Feature is completely inert when flag is false (no imports, no side effects)

data.dependency_graph: 06 and 01 can be built in parallel (no deps) → 02 depends on 01 → 03 depends on 02 → 04 depends on 03 → 05 depends on 04. Item 06 should be done early as it gates integration testing.
